---
title: "Case Study"
---

https://pudding.cool/2020/07/gendered-descriptions/

What do we like?
*Provocative title that catches the eye. 
*It’s written as a story; there is a specific order that readers need to view this.
*Interactive element of guessing which gender certain passages are referring too.
*Illustrations and artistic bent to the data structure.
*User-directed viewing, the viewer can hover over graphs to find more information/ change the graph to find   more information. 
*Animation/movement to give the viz more life.
*Discussion of the end of how the data is used.
